item.title: Apollo 13 didn't orbit the Moon to return
item.description:
Discover the story of Apollo 13, the mission that transformed a cosmic disaster into salvation.

Oxygen pressure plummeted. Apollo 13, drifting thousands of kilometers from Earth, depended on an unprecedented orbital maneuver for three lives. Do you know the master plan?

In 1970, Apollo 13 was en route to the Moon when an explosion turned the spacecraft into a frozen, oxygen-depleted survival capsule. Far from Earth, with systems failing, Jim Lovell's crew faced the brutal vacuum and vastness of space. Precise orbital physics would be the key to rescue, but at what cost, and how could a drifting spacecraft find its way back?

⏱️ Chapters

01:21 Numbers on Houston control center screens
03:10 Reverberation lit up main red light
05:03 Lifeboat crossing vacuum without sufficient power
